rationale: Two canonical delivery SQL status updates were physically moved into fixed, authenticated private QA owner commands. Owner independently verifies the expiry timestamp or grant use limit and applies only a deny-first conditional update. Caller still denies already-expired or exhausted bearer tokens if private status maintenance cannot be contacted. Seven remaining delivery SQL identities are source-identical and re-fingerprinted. No new positive entitlement or delivery token is issued; production legal authority remains locked. Combined distinct entitlement-device retirement is independently source-reconciled; no positive permission path is enabled.

files.review: Two negative grant-status SQL sites retired; seven protected or nonauthorizing source SQL candidates remain byte-for-byte unchanged. Two independently reviewed entitlement-device commands have also migrated; five remaining delivery SQL sites preserve their SQL literals and classifications.
